description: Implement token bucket rate limiter in TypeScript
prompt: Implement a TokenBucket rate limiter class in src/rateLimiter.ts with capacity, refillRate, and tryConsume(tokens = 1): boolean method.
requirements: TokenBucket constructor accepts capacity: number and refillRatePerSecond: number
tryConsume returns true when enough tokens exist and false otherwise
Tokens refill dynamically over elapsed time up to capacity
